description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the RefreshTokenRepository, testing CRUD operations, token revocation, and state checks for OAuth refresh tokens within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepositoryTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing RefreshTokenRepository functionalities including creating, persisting, revoking, and verifying refresh tokens in OAuth context.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment and populates test data via a YAML fixture before each test case.

methods.name: testGetNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Verifies that the repository returns a new instance of RefreshTokenEntity.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Tests persisting a new refresh token and verifies stored values including expiry and associations.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessTokenWithExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to persist a refresh token with a duplicate identifier triggers a unique constraint violation.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that revoking a refresh token updates its revoked status to true.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessTokenWhichAlreadyRevoked
methods.description: Checks that revoking an already revoked token does not modify state further.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures no errors occur when revoking a token that does not exist.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Tests that revoked tokens are correctly identified as revoked.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevokedForNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that non-existent tokens are considered revoked, meaning the system treats unknown tokens as revoked.
